name: Shihao Liu
bio: My research focuses on vision-language models and fine-grained image-text matching. I design methods for cross-modal alignment that capture both global semantics and local visual details.
research: My research lies at the intersection of computer vision and deep learning. My work centers on improving fine-grained alignment between vision and language, particularly in long-text scenarios where capturing subtle visual details is critical. I develop dual-branch encoders that separately model global semantics and local features, and design evaluation metrics that go beyond coarse CLIP scores to reward precise, detail-aware matching.
